incident-bot: AUTOPAGE -> PagerDuty: service=inference-api severity=high reason="canary 5xx spike" pd_incident=INC1768188
PD Bot: PagerDuty: INC1768188 triggered, auto-notifications sent.
Maya (SRE): I'm oncall, taking this. brief please?
Ashwin (Oncall): saw the page. Canary rollout v2.4.1 started ~10m ago, 20% traffic. p99 latencies ok but 5xx rate jumped to ~12% on /v1/generate
James (Platform): linking telemetry dashboard: https://dash.redwood/services/inference-api?range=15m
Elena (SRE): quick look at logs -> tokenizer-service returning 502->503. stack shows "quant-worker: segfault" on decode path
DeployBot: deploy id=deploy-20260315-2345 applied v2.4.1 to canary
Maya (SRE): can we divert traffic off the canary? rollback if safer. Thoughts?
Ashwin (Oncall): prefer divert first. if gateway supports weighted routing: reduce canary to 0% and shift to stable.
James (Platform): I can change traffic split. running:
```
# scale canary to 0%
redwood routing set-weights --service inference-api --weights stable=100,canary=0
```
James (Platform): executing now.
James (Platform): ok, command succeeded. routing change propagated.
Elena (SRE): watching error rate... still elevated for a minute then dropping. maybe cached KV from canary persisted.
Maya (SRE): PD bot: acknowledge
PD Bot: Incident INC1768188 acknowledged by Maya (SRE)
Ashwin (Oncall): logs from quant-worker container (canary nodes):
```
[ERROR] 2026-03-15T23:45:12Z decode(): segfault at 0x0
backtrace: libquant.so +0x1a2f
``` 
Ashwin (Oncall): looks like a real crash in quant path on v2.4.1. if diverting fixed customer impact, rolling rollback recommended.
James (Platform): initiating rollback to v2.4.0 for canary group:
```
# rollback canary
redwood deploy rollback --service inference-api --target v2.4.0 --subset canary
```
DeployBot: rollback job started job_id=rb-1768188
Maya (SRE): monitoring rollout
Elena (SRE): while rollback happens, I'm going to mute noisy alerts for this incident so we don't get duplicate autopages (:mute:)
Maya (SRE): rollback completed according to deploy system. verifying external metrics...
James (Platform): gateway telemetry back to baseline: 5xx -> 0.6% over 10m window
Ashwin (Oncall): confirming quant-worker pods on canary are now v2.4.0 and stable
Elena (SRE): customer-facing errors resolved, no active P0s reported by CS. flagging for Customer Impact review.
PD Bot: Incident INC1768188 status: resolved by Maya (SRE) — auto-close in 10m unless reopened
Maya (SRE): creating follow-up ticket: TICKET-9876 "canary v2.4.1 quant-worker segfault - rollback and analysis"
Maya (SRE): assigning to eng-runtime (Ashwin, James) and tagging eng-ml for quant path analysis
Ashwin (Oncall): quick notes: reproduce locally with sample model and v2.4.1 quant kernels. suspect regression in mem alignment after quant optimization.
Claudia (SRE): I'm next oncall. handoff: please add any postmortem notes to TICKET-9876 and I'll schedule a blameless postmortem. acked.
Maya (SRE): thanks all. closing thread when PD auto-closes. follow-ups: verify canary gating and add stricter smoke checks for quant path in rollout pipeline.
PD Bot: Incident INC1768188 closed (auto) — final note: no customer escalations. :white_check_mark:
